اذلوليا (form XII)
# اِذْلَوْلَيَا (iḏlawlayā) /ið.law.la.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِذْلَوْلَى (iḏlawlā)
# اِذْلَوْلِيَا (iḏlawliyā) /ið.law.li.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِذْلَوْلَى (iḏlawlā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
